name: Manual-Assisted Bagging
summary: Manual-assisted bagging equipment, working with automated machinery to complete product bagging packaging.
contentHtml:
The Manual-Assisted Bagging Machine is a manual-assisted device developed by TXAM for the bagging packaging process.

Working Principle

The equipment works with manual operation to achieve semi-automated bagging packaging, improving packaging efficiency while reducing equipment investment.

Technical Advantages

  • Combination of manual and automation, flexible and efficient
  • Guaranteed bagging quality
  • Reduced equipment investment costs
  • Easy to operate, low training costs
